text: function-testing 是一项面向 DSH 技能机制的功能测试用例生成技能。入口读取并解析 SKILL.md 的元数据，将技能内容注册到运行时技能列表，并在释放时注销。它指导代理分析 PRD、Git 提交记录或用户故事，提取可测试功能点，设计覆盖正向、异常、边界、状态切换和数据一致性的用例，并按 P0、P1、P2 标注优先级。技能还定义测试概述、功能点清单和测试用例等 Excel 报告工作表及样式要求，适合需要把需求整理成测试计划的开发者和 QA。代码未声明额外密钥或外部服务配置。

function-testing turns PRDs, commits, or user stories into prioritized test cases. It registers SKILL.md as a DSH skill and guides positive, error, boundary, state, and consistency coverage. It outlines an Excel report with overview, feature, and case sheets. No keys or services are declared.
我有一份 PRD，想快速拆成可执行的功能测试用例。
能根据一段用户故事整理正向和异常测试场景吗？
让 AI 从 Git 提交或 diff 中提取需要验证的功能点。
我希望测试清单能覆盖边界条件和状态切换。
把需求转成带 P0、P1、P2 优先级的测试方案。
我想生成包含测试概述、功能列表和用例的 Excel 报告结构。
需求验收时怎样系统地检查正向、异常和数据一致性？
Turn a product requirement into prioritized functional test cases.
Create a QA checklist from a user story or a commit diff.
Help me cover edge cases, state changes, and data consistency in testing.
function-testing 的功能「需求拆解」：分析 PRD、Git 提交记录或用户故事，识别材料类型并提取可测试的功能点。使用者通过技能机制调用后提供需求材料，代理据此形成测试对象清单。
function-testing 的功能「场景用例设计」：针对提取的功能点设计测试用例，按需覆盖正向、异常、边界、状态切换和数据一致性场景，并可标注 P0、P1、P2 优先级。
function-testing 的功能「Excel 报告结构」：技能给出测试概述、功能点清单和测试用例三类工作表所需字段，并说明表头、换行、边框和冻结首行等格式要求。

dsh-skill-function-testing README · Function Testing：[](https://skills.sh/addxing/function-testing)

A skill for generating functional test cases from PRDs, Git commits, or user stories, and exporting an Excel-style test report. Works with AI coding tools that support Agent Skills.

dsh-skill-function-testing README · Install：```bash
npx skills add addxing/function-testing
```

dsh-skill-function-testing README · DeepSeek Harness：This repo follows the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Skill format. Clone it into a skills directory and it will be auto-discovered:

```bash
dsh-skill-function-testing README · User-level install (available in all projects)：git clone https://github.com/addxing/function-testing ~/.dsh/skills/function-testing

dsh-skill-function-testing README · Project-level install (current project only)：git clone https://github.com/addxing/function-testing .dsh/skills/function-testing
```

DSH hot-reloads the skills directory after cloning; the skill becomes available in new sessions.

Or install it as an official bundle plugin in one line (requires pnpm; restart the web app afterwards):bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:addxing/function-testing#main"
```

dsh-skill-function-testing README · Usage：Select this skill using your tool’s skill mechanism, or ask for it by name. Invocation syntax and automatic activation depend on the tool.

After installing the skill, ask your AI agent to use it when you need functional test cases:

```text
Use the function-testing skill to generate test cases for this PRD.
```

For best results, provide one of:

- a PRD or requirements document
- Git commit details or a diff
- a user story or feature description

dsh-skill-function-testing README · What It Does：This skill guides an agent to:

- analyze the input material and identify its source type
- extract testable functional points
- design concise test cases covering positive, negative, boundary, state transition, and data consistency scenarios
- assign priorities such as P0, P1, and P2
- generate an Excel report with overview, feature list, and test case sheets
